body: {"sql":"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS typology_precomputed_results (result_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), case_id UUID NOT NULL, typology_module_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, sub_category_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, overall_score FLOAT NOT NULL, match_strength VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, cosine_similarity FLOAT, flag_score FLOAT, key_entities JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT \u0027[]\u0027, subgraph_summary JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT \u0027{}\u0027, narrative TEXT, synthesis_status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT \u0027completed\u0027, is_stale BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, computed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), UNIQUE(case_id, typology_module_id, sub_category_id));"}
